subject.title: gateway: malformed managed image data URLs can stall reply handling

question: Should maintainers proceed with the public linked gateway ReDoS fix PR, or route this issue through private security handling first?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and already proposed, but the affected path is untrusted model-supplied media parsing on a stable gateway availability boundary.

options.title: Proceed with public fix PR
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102411, confirm the validation semantics, and land it through the normal security-aware maintainer path.

options.title: Route through security handling
options.body: Pause the public PR path and handle the denial-of-service report through the repository security process before public landing.

options.title: Keep owner-managed
options.body: Leave the issue open for a gateway owner to patch manually if maintainers want tighter control over sibling regex scope.

recommendation.title: Proceed with public fix PR
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102411, confirm the validation semantics, and land it through the normal security-aware maintainer path.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is ownership of the managed outgoing image feature and later managed-image hardening.
